title: Notice and Fatal error when analyzing an incorrectly structured docblock
body:
Example PHP file:
```php
<?php

/**
 * @return array, an array of very important data
 */
function test()
{
}
```
Configuration (subset of the default configuraion):
```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<psalm>
    <issueHandlers>
        <InvalidDocblock errorLevel="info" />
    </issueHandlers>
</psalm>
```
Output (psalm 0.3.46):
```
$ psalm test.php 
Notice:  Undefined variable: docblock_return_type in vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/FunctionLikeChecker.php on line 832

INFO: InvalidDocblock - test.php:6 - Cannot parse comma in non-generic/array type in docblock for test

Fatal error:  Uncaught Error: Call to a member function setFromDocblock() on null in vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/FunctionLikeChecker.php:833
Stack trace:
#0 vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/FunctionChecker.php(45): Psalm\Checker\FunctionLikeChecker::register(Object(PhpParser\Node\Stmt\Function_), Object(Psalm\Checker\FunctionChecker))
#1 vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/FileChecker.php(235): Psalm\Checker\FunctionChecker->__construct(Object(PhpParser\Node\Stmt\Function_), Object(Psalm\Checker\FileChecker))
#2 vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/ProjectChecker.php(729): Psalm\Checker\FileChecker->visit()
#3 vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/ProjectChecker.php(693): Psalm\Checker\ProjectChecker->visitFile('/home/morozov/M...', Array, true)
#4 vendor/vimeo/psalm/bin/psalm(332): Psalm\Checker\ProjectChecker->checkFile('/home/morozov/M. in vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/FunctionLikeChecker.php on line 833
```
